section_1.title: Foundation year guide
section_1.description: When you do not meet direct entry requirements, a foundation year can be a practical route into a full degree.

section_2.title: What students usually need to know.
section_2.description: Clear, useful guidance designed for mature students who want a realistic route into university.

cards.title: Year 0 route
cards.description: A foundation year is normally the first year before Year 1 of the degree.

cards.title: Good for missing Level 3
cards.description: It can help if you do not have A-levels or an Access course.

cards.title: Often funded
cards.description: Integrated foundation years can usually be considered for Student Finance if eligible.

cards.title: Progression matters
cards.description: Check whether passing the year leads automatically to the degree.

cards.title: Subject fit
cards.description: Choose a foundation year linked to the degree you actually want.

cards.title: Best for confidence
cards.description: It helps rebuild academic skills before the main degree.

section_3.title: Turn this guide into a plan.
section_3.description: We can help you compare routes, understand funding and prepare your application documents.
section_3.ctaDescription: Start with eligibility, then speak to an adviser if you want human support.
